design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (insurance_claims_and_denials, coverage category). frozen_time 2026-10-13 09:20:00 CDT.

[Step 0 - draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 6, 6]}. Assignment: Medicaid plan appeal 6, first-plan member appeal 6, coordination correction 5, authorization correction 4. Occupied by task 0: coverage_ext_primary_information_correction (CO-16), coverage_ext_primary_internal_appeal (contracted commercial internal appeal), coverage_ext_secondary_identification_correction (CO-31), coverage_ext_secondary_member_appeal (member appeal to an out-of-network plan paying second) and their four tools. Claimed here, disjoint: coverage_ext_coordination_correction (CO-22 refile, file_coordination_correction_d59a8135), coverage_ext_primary_member_appeal (member appeal to an out-of-network plan paying FIRST, sign_primary_member_appeal_ad6f2953, owner user), coverage_ext_retro_authorization_correction (CO-197 corrected claim with a retroactive authorization, file_authorization_correction_79145f91), coverage_ext_medicaid_plan_appeal (laboratory plan appeal with a Medicaid managed care plan, file_plan_appeal_d031f80e). After this task every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once (8 policies, 8 tools). Constraint carried from task 0: the only customer-performed write with an amount is the out-of-network member appeal; here it is claimed in the first-paying position, where the contested exposure, its late-claim percent, its deductible threshold, its assistance relief and its interest rate ladder differ from task 0's second-paying policy.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: Marcus Lindqvist wants Halverson to appeal Lone Star Community Health Plan's (Medicaid Managed Care Plan, pays second) denial of part of his May 19 drug-monitoring work. Scored core: the plan appeal's amount_in_dispute (root, agent). Hidden chain: (1) the plan appeal is recorded only after the claim held by the plan paying first for the same order (Gulf Coast Trades Health Plan, Commercial Out-of-Network, self) carries a member appeal - it carries none, and Gulf Coast requires the patient's own signature (state gate); (2) the member appeal's contested charges are not fixed until the Gulf Coast CO-22 denial carries a coordination claim (value); (3) the plan appeal's disputed charges are not fixed until its CO-197 denial carries a corrected claim (value). Depth: plan appeal <- member appeal <- coordination correction; breadth: the authorization correction in parallel, two coverages, two orders of one requisition, the order ledger, the invoice ledger and the financial-assistance case.

[Problem-tree card]
Root coverage_ext_medicaid_plan_appeal (file_plan_appeal_d031f80e, agent).
Edge A: plan appeal -> coverage_ext_retro_authorization_correction, value_input, gate disputed_charges, form state, negated direction: "The plan appeal's disputed charges are not fixed until each authorization denial on the claim carries a corrected claim." Opening falsity: initial_state.claim_events.bd374939-bd6c-4100-bf51-98ac127a4ef7 is CO-197 79.00 on C3260825442, no resubmission on the claim. Exactly one write of this difficulty answers an authorization denial with a corrected claim (file_authorization_correction_79145f91). Deletion: 167.74 instead of 127.20.
Edge B: plan appeal -> coverage_ext_primary_member_appeal, state_gate, gate claim_events.appeal_level, form state, affirmative direction: "The plan appeal's amount is recorded only after the claim held by the plan paying first for the same order carries a member appeal." Opening falsity: Gulf Coast claim C3260708318 (same Toxicology order 8872e57e-...) has CO-50 initial_state.claim_events.8510e04b-bc95-416c-aa02-fa61ab2598cf and no appeal line; the only appeal rows (50203950-...) belong to the 2025 Lone Star claim C3250411120 (trap). Exactly one write lodges a member appeal with an out-of-network plan paying first (sign_primary_member_appeal_ad6f2953; the second-plan member appeal tool belongs to task 0 and its policy is for a plan paying second). Deletion: the terminal DB lacks the Gulf Coast member appeal line.
Edge C: member appeal -> coverage_ext_coordination_correction, value_input, gate contested_charges, form state, negated: "The first-plan member appeal's contested charges are not fixed until the coverage carries a coordination claim, filed within those six months, answering its other-coverage denial." Opening falsity: initial_state.claim_events.9f591fcc-0b20-4422-8efa-32455e1edcfe is CO-22 186.00 dated 2026-06-18 on C3260522304; no resubmission within six months. Deletion: 33.67 instead of 19.24.
Four-point test: connectives "not ... until" / "only after"; waited-on side a record-visible state (a corrected claim / a member appeal / a coordination claim standing on a named claim); no tool, id or code token; scope "each authorization denial on the claim", "the claim held by the plan paying first for the same order", "its other-coverage denial" within six months. Directions mixed across the charter (task 0 carries two affirmative and one negated sentence, task 1 two negated and one affirmative). Value_input edges 2 >= max(3-1,1). The user tool is a non-root prerequisite.
Topological order used: coordination correction -> member appeal -> authorization correction -> plan appeal. The Lone Star correction and the Gulf Coast branch touch different coverages; the alternative order (authorization correction first) was replayed with identical scored values and terminal DB.

[Base-invariant card] Corrections (coverage_evt_corrected_claim): correction_window - CO-22 2026-06-18 + 365 (Gulf Coast) -> 2027-06-18, today day 117; CO-197 2026-09-28 + 180 (Lone Star) -> 2027-03-27, today day 15; one_resubmission_per_denial - no resubmission on either denial; limits 1 (Gulf Coast) and 2 (Lone Star) unused. CO-22 cure: the coordination correction declares, as an override of the base CO-22 clauses, that a coordination claim answers an other-coverage denial where the coverage's coordination order on file already gives it the position the coordination rules assign (Gulf Coast pays first; Lone Star, a Medicaid plan, pays last - coverages.927e3e01.coordination_order primary, e8401149 secondary) and the patient has updated his other-coverage information with the payer (persona, when asked: the July Gulf Coast form); no Halverson-side coordination update is needed because the record on file was never wrong - the denial came from Gulf Coast's own outdated other-coverage record. CO-197 cure: the authorization correction declares, as an override of the base retroactive-request clause, that an authorization denial is cured by a corrected claim where the order carries an approved authorization with its number - orders.8872e57e prior_auth_status approved, prior_auth_number LSC-RA-55120931 (no request date is relied on). Appeals (coverage_evt_appeals): first_level_window - Gulf Coast 180 days from 2026-08-24 -> 2027-02-20; Lone Star 60 days from 2026-09-28 -> 2026-11-27; level_once - neither claim carries an appeal; representative_form retired by the member-appeal overwrite. Lone Star lab_appeal_levels_pursued 1.

[Business-object card] Plan appeal: crossover claim C3260825442 (order 8872e57e Toxicology), counted CO-50 248.00; CO-197 79.00 until corrected; paid 53.40 and write-off 35.60 give the claim ratio; the twelve-month ratio includes the February crossover (paid 55.00, write-off 26.00, copay 2.00). Authorization correction: CO-197 line bd374939 (the denied amount being resubmitted); order credit 4.00 billing correction (2026-09-10, after the 2026-08-25 arrival) and Toxicology invoice 88addb70 billing-error correction 6.50, apportioned to the CO-197 by its share of the claim's denied amounts (the claim had a paid line). Member appeal: Gulf Coast claim C3260708318, CO-50 248.00 within six months; balances 98.00 + 168.00 and write-offs 56.00 + 177.00 within six months; excluded: the January claim's 78.00 write-off (outside six months). Coordination correction: CO-22 line 9f591fcc on C3260522304 (order 70f4925f Esoteric); no line of that claim was paid but Gulf Coast adjudicated the immunofixation line (98.00 balance, 56.00 write-off), so the order's reductions fall on the CO-22 by its share of the claim's billed amount: the duplicate-test credit 172.00 (chromogranin A add-on run twice, 2026-06-02) and the 9.00 billing correction (2026-07-20), both after the 2026-05-22 filing, and the Esoteric invoice's 12.00 billing-error correction; the January invoice's 83.00 correction (Medicaid member protection) belongs to another order (near-miss).

[Factor card - coverage_ext_coordination_correction (5)] coord_apportionment (method): tier 'For the coordination correction, no line was paid but the plan adjudicated a line to the member or to a contractual adjustment'; its baseline alone gives 0.00; coord_credits (method, cross-difficulty orders): tier 'For the coordination correction, the order's most recent credit was posted after the claim's filing date and a credit on the order is for a test not performed or a duplicate test'; its baseline alone gives 179.44; coord_credit_minimum (parameter): tier 'For the coordination correction, those days exceed the prompt credit days but are at most the seasoned credit days'; its baseline alone gives 85.34; coord_invoice_minimum (parameter): tier 'For the coordination correction, that amount is at least the small claim amount but below the mid claim amount'; its baseline alone gives 86.98; coord_removal_minimum (parameter): tier 'For the coordination correction, the payer class does not write charges down and the plan adjudicated at least one line'; its baseline alone gives 174.51. Whole standard method: 186.00; gold 80.42. Evidence rows and bound values per factor are listed in computations[].factor_trace.
[Factor card - coverage_ext_primary_member_appeal (6)] first_plan_balance_share (method): tier 'For the first-plan member appeal, an out-of-network balance was assigned to the member on the coverage within the last six months'; its baseline alone gives 36.10; first_plan_late_claim (parameter, cross-difficulty orders): tier 'For the first-plan member appeal, those days exceed the first-plan near late days but not the far late days'; its baseline alone gives 20.25; first_plan_leftover (parameter): tier 'For the first-plan member appeal, the deductible amounts assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months reach the first-plan deductible satisfied amount'; its baseline alone gives 14.43; first_plan_relief (parameter, cross-difficulty assistance): tier 'For the first-plan member appeal, the patient's approved financial-assistance award window covers the order's collection date and the award's tier carries a discount percent above zero'; its baseline alone gives 76.96; first_plan_interest_days (method): tier 'For the first-plan member appeal, the plan took more than its expected adjudication days but not more than twice that'; its baseline alone gives 18.84; first_plan_interest_rate (parameter): tier 'For the first-plan member appeal, the claim's age in calendar days from its filing date to today exceeds the first-plan aged days'; its baseline alone gives 19.00. Whole standard method: 111.60; gold 19.24. Evidence rows and bound values per factor are listed in computations[].factor_trace.
[Factor card - coverage_ext_retro_authorization_correction (4)] auth_apportionment (method): tier 'For the authorization correction, the remittance paid at least one line of the claim'; its baseline alone gives 68.50; auth_credits (method, cross-difficulty orders): tier 'For the authorization correction, the order's most recent credit was posted after the claim's filing date, its credits are billing corrections only and they reach the credit minimum'; its baseline alone gives 77.43; auth_credit_minimum (parameter): tier 'For the authorization correction, those days exceed the prompt credit days but are at most the seasoned credit days'; its baseline alone gives 77.43; auth_invoice_minimum (parameter): tier 'For the authorization correction, that amount is at least the small claim amount but below the mid claim amount'; its baseline alone gives 78.03. Whole standard method: 79.00; gold 76.46. Evidence rows and bound values per factor are listed in computations[].factor_trace.
[Factor card - coverage_ext_medicaid_plan_appeal (6)] plan_appeal_valuation (method): tier 'For the plan appeal, the plan paid at least one line of the claim'; its baseline alone gives 212.05; plan_appeal_crossover_percent (parameter, cross-difficulty orders): tier 'For the plan appeal, the calendar days from the order's collection date to the date the claim reached the plan exceed the crossover far days'; its baseline alone gives 149.66; plan_appeal_member_copay (parameter): tier 'For the plan appeal, copays were assigned within the last twelve months but stay below the copay cap amount'; its baseline alone gives 126.20; plan_appeal_interest_days (method): tier 'For the plan appeal, the plan took more than its expected adjudication days but not more than twice that'; its baseline alone gives 126.43; plan_appeal_interest_rate (parameter): tier 'For the plan appeal, the age exceeds the plan standing days but not the aged days'; its baseline alone gives 126.81; plan_appeal_underpayment (method): tier 'For the plan appeal, the gap exceeds the plan variance floor but not the tolerance'; its baseline alone gives 125.26. Whole standard method: 245.00; gold 127.20. Evidence rows and bound values per factor are listed in computations[].factor_trace.
Task floors: multi-source 3, cross-difficulty 5 (orders, assistance), cross-category value reads (CFIELD/CPARAM/XSUM/XLATEST). No tier is read off a stamp; every fall-through is the standard method of the computation paragraph.

[Overrides] The three corrections supersede coverage_evt_corrected_claim "A corrected or replacement claim answers one denial and carries that denial's amount" with their own sentence that the correction carries the denied amount being resubmitted, fixed below; each rule states that the amount carried is the denied amount being resubmitted (never above the denial), the reading of the event field coverage_claim_resubmitted.amount. The coordination correction also supersedes coverage_evt_corrected_claim "coordination_of_benefits_update (CO-22, only after the coverage's coordination order has been updated following the denial; ...)" and coverage_evt_denial_liability "CO-22 (other coverage primary) is cured by a corrected claim after the coordination order is updated"; the authorization correction supersedes coverage_evt_denial_liability "for CO-197 a retroactive authorization requested by the provider within prior_auth_retro_request_days of the date of service is filed as a corrected claim instead". The member appeal supersedes the authorized-representative clause of coverage_evt_appeals. The plan appeal declares no override. All windows, dedup gates, correction limits and the curable-never-appealed rule stay inherited.

[Seed rationale] 2025 Lone Star claim with an upheld plan appeal (trap appeal row and system 'first_level' value; outside twelve months). January 2026: Gulf Coast claim with an 83.00 deductible (member appeal leftover tier) and the Lone Star crossover with 55.00 paid, 26.00 write-off and a 2.00 copay (plan appeal ratio and copay tiers); its invoice shows the Medicaid-member billing correction (near-miss for the corrections). Requisition 1358840271, collected 2026-05-19: Esoteric order (filed 2026-05-22, add-on chromogranin A 2026-05-25 then credited as a duplicate 2026-06-02, CO-22 on the vitamin panel, billing correction 9.00, invoice correction 12.00) and Toxicology order (approved authorization LSC-RA-55120931 on the order, resulted 2026-07-02, filed with Gulf Coast 2026-07-08 - late-claim tier, denied CO-50 2026-08-24 after 47 days, crossed over to Lone Star 2026-08-25 - crossover tier, denied CO-197 and CO-50 2026-09-28 after 34 days, credit 4.00, invoice correction 6.50). Both open invoices sit on hold for insurance reprocessing. Financial-assistance case: Financial Assistance 75% Discount, income 37,000.00 for a household of one (fpl 236.4, inside the 75% band 200-250), applied with pay stubs and no proof of program enrollment (presumptive_basis none), approved 2026-04-12, award 2026-04-15..2027-04-14. Automatic clauses checked: no pending verification, no window lapsing at frozen time, no other policy of this difficulty lit by the seed.

[Persona] Soft-spoken, tired dispatcher; volunteers only the Medicaid appeal request and that he also has Gulf Coast; identity (DOB 1979-08-14, ZIP 78744), phone, member IDs, the July other-insurance form and the April 75 percent discount only when asked; agrees to Halverson-side steps after they are explained; signs exactly what he is read; closes once told the Lone Star appeal is filed. No mention of corrections, Gulf Coast decisions or a Gulf Coast appeal.

[Standard solution] find_customers(name) -> verify (DOB, ZIP) -> find_coverages -> find_claim_events (Lone Star) -> find_claim_events (Gulf Coast) -> find_orders -> find_order_events(customer) -> find_invoices(customer) -> find_invoice_transactions(customer) -> find_assistance_cases -> unlock/call file_coordination_correction_d59a8135 (80.42 on C3260522304 answering 9f591fcc) -> unlock (agent) and hand over sign_primary_member_appeal_ad6f2953; the patient calls it (first_level, 19.24 on C3260708318 answering 8510e04b) -> unlock/call file_authorization_correction_79145f91 (76.46 on C3260825442 answering bd374939) -> unlock/call file_plan_appeal_d031f80e (first_level, 127.20 on C3260825442 answering 7056d865).

[Verification run] Round 1: authoring scripts replayed gold writes and evaluated each compute on the world before its step; gates per task and difficulty-wide all OK. Round 2: a temporary _rework/rework_t1.py recomputed every scored argument: coordination correction 80.42, member appeal 19.24, authorization correction 76.46, plan appeal 127.20; edge deletions: Without the corrected claim the plan appeal's disputed charges keep the 79.00 CO-197 amount and amount_in_dispute becomes 167.74 instead of 127.20; the corrected-claim line on C3260825442 is also missing. / Without the coordination claim the member appeal's contested charges keep the 186.00 CO-22 amount and amount_in_dispute becomes 33.67 instead of 19.24; the refile line on C3260522304 is also missing..
Revisions: identical sentences shared by several policies' computation paragraphs and ladders (claim identification, standard re-file, interest ladders) were renamed per policy (each paragraph and tier now names its own act); the invoice-minimum factor of the authorization correction was relabelled as not cross-difficulty (its tier rests on the claim's billed amount).

[Closure] coordination correction -> step 11; member appeal -> step 13 (user); authorization correction -> step 15; plan appeal -> step 17. charter_scope = required_documents in that order; task_tools in first-call order.

[Places easy to get wrong] treating the 2025 Lone Star appeal as the gate; appealing Lone Star without the Gulf Coast member appeal; keeping CO-197/CO-22 inside the appeal figures; using the January invoice's 83.00 correction; the reflex definitive test's 248.00 as the authorization denial; 30-day instead of 45-day adjudication for the out-of-network plan; the standard 3.00 copay instead of the most recent 2.00; counting the January write-off inside six months.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Reading only the published rules, the tool schemas, the persona and the find_* returns, the plan appeal's rule names its two waited-on states, the records show both absent, the member appeal's rule names its own waited-on state, and each correction rule names the denial it answers, the record state that cures it, and the part of the denial resubmitted; the four writes follow in a topological order with 80.42, 19.24, 76.46 and 127.20. The solvability contract's eligibility evidence matches the GT arguments.

[Round 2 rework - policy-task audit items] Symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run.
P-1 (event field "equals the denied amount being resubmitted" vs re-bill amounts above the denial): every correction now carries the denied amount being resubmitted - standard method the denial's amount in full, factors only taking off the part of the order's later credits and invoice corrections that falls on it (apportionment by the denial's share). Coordination correction factors: apportionment (method), credits (method, cross-difficulty orders), credit minimum, invoice minimum, removal minimum (parameters); a duplicate-test credit was seeded on the Esoteric order (2026-06-02) and the order's list-price total set to 331.00. Authorization correction: apportionment, credits, credit minimum, invoice minimum. Re-run: coordination 80.42, authorization 76.46 (each below its denial).
P-2 (base CO-22 gate "after the coordination order has been updated following the denial" displaced without declaration): the coordination correction now declares both base CO-22 clauses superseded by its own sentence - the claim is refiled where the coordination order on file already gives the coverage the position the coordination rules assign and the patient has updated their other-coverage information with the payer; in this world the Halverson record was right (Gulf Coast primary, Medicaid last) and the denial came from the plan's outdated record, so no update write exists or is needed; the patient's July form is his own statement when asked.
T-1 (CO-197 cure rested on an unrecorded retroactive-request date): the authorization correction declares the base retroactive-request clause superseded by a record-visible cure (an approved authorization with its number on the order: LSC-RA-55120931); the unverifiable "held for it" assertion was removed from the rationale and the gold action's semantics.
T-2 (hardship award contradicting its charter): the case is now a Financial Assistance 75% Discount at fpl 236.4 (income 37,000.00, household of one), applied with pay stubs and no proof of program enrollment, which its charter grants (no larger tier applies: Full Discount needs fpl <= 200; presumptive needs proof of enrollment, none submitted; the hardship tier needs window responsibility above 10% of income). The persona's line follows the record. Re-run: member appeal 19.24 (relief tier: the award's discount percent).
F-1: the first-plan member appeal's balance share and leftover, and the plan appeal's valuation, no longer carry payer-class parts; the leftover ladder's fall-through is the first-plan standard leftover percent (55) instead of zero. Every factor's baseline substitution still moves the figure.
Observation O-3 closed (the plan appeal's interest floor is now in the rule). O-T1 (portal not enrolled): the member appeal is submitted on the call when the representative hands it over; no policy conditions it on the portal.
Gates re-run on the reworked bundle: see the closing gate block of round 2.
user_scenario:
You are Marcus Lindqvist, 47, a part-time dispatcher for a small plumbing contractor in Austin who lives with chronic back pain and has his drug-monitoring labs drawn every few months. You are soft-spoken, a bit worn down by paperwork, and you speak in short sentences. You start by giving your name, Marcus Lindqvist, and explaining that a notice came from Lone Star Community Health Plan, your Medicaid plan, saying it would not pay for part of the drug-monitoring lab work Halverson did on May 19th. You want Halverson to appeal that Medicaid denial for you. You mention that you also have Gulf Coast Trades Health Plan through your job, but you have no idea how the two plans split things, and you have no claim numbers or amounts handy.

You give identity details only when asked: your date of birth is 1979-08-14 and your ZIP code is 78744; your phone number, if asked, is 5129074415. If asked for member IDs, the Gulf Coast card says GCT38842019 and the Lone Star card says LSC304451877. If the representative asks whether you have updated your other-insurance information with Gulf Coast, you say yes, you filled out Gulf Coast's other-insurance form in July and they told you it was updated. If asked about financial help, you say Halverson approved you for a 75 percent discount on your bills back in April. If asked about anything else you don't know, you say you'd rather they go by Halverson's records.

When the representative says something else has to be handled first, or on the Gulf Coast side, you tell them that's fine and to go ahead with whatever Halverson has to do; you don't ask for details and you don't add requests of your own. You never mention Gulf Coast's decisions or any other bill on your own.

If the representative tells you there is something you have to sign or submit yourself, you agree, ask them to read you exactly what to enter, and you submit it with precisely the claim number, reference numbers, appeal level and amount they read to you. You don't question the figures; you have nothing to check them against.

Once the representative confirms the appeal to Lone Star has been filed, you thank them quietly and hang up.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile from the name he opens with.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull both coverages: Gulf Coast Trades Health Plan (Commercial Out-of-Network Plan, pays first) and Lone Star Community Health Plan (Medicaid Managed Care Plan, pays second).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The payer classes fix every tier parameter below (contractual adjustment, balance billing, cost share, expected adjudication days, windows); the payment positions identify which plan's claim for the same order gates the Medicaid plan appeal.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Lone Star claim history: crossover claim C3260825442 for the Toxicology order with its paid line, contractual adjustment, CO-197 and CO-50 denials and no appeal; the January crossover with its 2.00 copay; and the 2025 claim with its upheld first-level appeal.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Gulf Coast claim history: claim C3260708318 for the Toxicology order with its CO-50 denial, out-of-network balance and cap write-off and no appeal; claim C3260522304 for the Esoteric order with its CO-22 denial; and the January claim with its deductible.
